thread:
marta: FYI PR #701 landed a troubleshooting appendix about 429s + context trimming but some of the SDK examples are stale vs 0.9. Can someone quick-scan?
eli: Point me to the lines and I can patch; want a tiny migration blurb too?
marta: Thanks. The top JS snippet uses `client.setOptions({max_concurrency: 10})` and an explicit `retryOn429: true` flag. In 0.9 the param is `concurrency_limit` and runtime manages retries through fallback policy, so remove the explicit flag.
noah: I'll submit a micro-PR to update the snippets and add a concise "What changed" callout. Keep the handbook small.
jena: Also please add a short section "If 429s increase after upgrade" with three fast actions: reduce concurrency_limit, enable prefix/KV cache, and add client-side exponential backoff with jitter.
eli: I'll add the code diff:```diff
- client.setOptions({max_concurrency: 10, retryOn429: true})
+ client.setOptions({concurrency_limit: 10})
```
noah: Suggest a staging repro command for troubleshooting: `hey -n 800 -c 60 https://staging.api.redwood/v1/generate` and a note to run from same region. Add a short sentence explaining higher batch_window lowers cost but can raise p99 under tight tails.
marta: Good. Add a minimal example in examples/ that runs the snippet against a local mock so CI will catch stale API names going forward.
doc-bot: added docs-qa checklist to PR #701: samples-lint, migration-note, example-ci, links-verified
jena: I'll write the migration copy and the tiny troubleshooting checklist by Tue EOD. noah: I'll wire the example test and land the snippet changes. Target to merge by Wed morning and include a short blurb in Wed docs sync.
marta: After merge, please backport the migration callout to the older troubleshooting page for SDK 0.8 users. doc-bot: queued backport issue post-merge :white_check_mark:
